digest.overview: Kimi K3 open weights drop today amid surging open-source momentum; Nvidia-led Open Secure AI Alliance launches without OpenAI/Anthropic/Google; Ilya Sutskever’s SSI secures Nvidia partnership for scaling.

top_story.headline: Kimi K3 weights released on Hugging Face
top_story.summary: Moonshot AI drops 2.8T-param Kimi K3 with Kimi Delta Attention, 1M context, native vision; non-commercial license requires deals above $20M revenue or 100M users.
top_story.why_it_matters: First open 3T-class model; community deploying on A100s/H200s/B300s immediately, testing if it matches closed frontier performance.

sentiment.label: bullish
sentiment.summary: LocalLLaMA and r/singularity flooded with excitement over Kimi K3 and open alliances; skepticism limited to license restrictions and SSI secrecy.

model_releases.headline: Kimi K3 weights released on Hugging Face
model_releases.summary: Moonshot AI drops 2.8T-param Kimi K3 with Kimi Delta Attention, 1M context, native vision; non-commercial license requires deals above $20M revenue or 100M users.

frontier_labs.headline: Safe Superintelligence partners with Nvidia to scale research
frontier_labs.summary: After two years stealth, Ilya Sutskever’s SSI announces long-term Nvidia partnership and large investment to 10x compute.

frontier_labs.headline: Nvidia, Microsoft launch Open Secure AI Alliance
frontier_labs.summary: 35 partners including IBM, Hugging Face, SpaceX, CrowdStrike form open-source AI security tools initiative; explicitly excludes OpenAI, Google, Anthropic.

influencer_takes.author: Nathan Lambert
influencer_takes.quote: Kimi K3 license. It's inspired by MIT but distinctly non-commercial, where any company making over $20M/yr must get a specific commercial deal (and display Kimi K3 if over 100M users or $20M/mo revenue)
influencer_takes.context: First detailed breakdown of the license terms as weights hit HF

research_radar.headline: RL & search is a terrifying way to build AGI (an FAQ)
research_radar.summary: Alignment Forum post argues any RL or model-based search/planning approach to AGI is inherently dangerous.

post_ideas.hook: Kimi K3 license carves out non-commercial tier at $20M revenue
post_ideas.draft: Moonshot just dropped the 2.8T Kimi K3 weights with a license that forces commercial deals above $20M/yr. Open weights but not open for big players without negotiation.
post_ideas.why_viral: License nuance surprises after pure open-weight hype; direct tension with 'open source wins' narrative

post_ideas.hook: Nvidia + Microsoft alliance skips every major closed lab
post_ideas.draft: Open Secure AI Alliance has 35 partners but zero OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic. Jensen explicitly called out the Hugging Face incident where open weights helped forensics.
post_ideas.why_viral: Industry split visible in real time; security angle adds stakes

post_ideas.hook: SSI gets Nvidia backing while staying in stealth
post_ideas.draft: Ilya’s Safe Superintelligence lands Nvidia investment to 10x compute. Two years in, still no model or paper, just scaling.
